description: Park and Ride is a dataset listed in Caltrans GIS Data hub, an open geospatial data hub of a state transportation department, published or maintained by Caltrans. Park and Ride Lots offer a convenient and safe location to transfer from a single passenger vehicle to a local or regional transit bus, carpool, or vanpool. Ridesharing saves you time and money, while reducing traffic congestion and energy consumption. Park & Ride Page. Coverage: California, United States. The hub lists this as a dataset of Caltrans. Its keywords are California Department of Transportation, California State Transportation Agency, CalSTA, Caltrans, CAOpenData, Lots, Park and Ride, Highway. The bounding box given is -124.1906,32.5664,-116.4572,41.2873. The hub shows 2024-09-09 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is a licence or disclaimer text is given on the hub listing (This application is being updated for digital accessibility and will continue to function while updates are in progress. ...); terms not read in full. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-caltrans-gis-data-hub.
